fields.Name: T187 - Resource Ratings Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies a Resource's full record form exposes a related Resource Ratings (or Resource Downloads) section that renders related rows or a valid empty-state.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Resources' entity via the left sidebar 'Search entities...' box: click the search box, type 'Resources', then click the exact 'Resources' node in the results (do NOT expand the entity group/chevron). Open a resource record's full form (click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'). Scroll down to the form's related-records sections and open the 'Resource Ratings' (or 'Resource Downloads') related section. Verify it shows related rows OR a valid empty-state (the related section being present and rendering is success). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait patiently, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Resource full record form is open showing resource detail fields
A related 'Resource Ratings' or 'Resource Downloads' section is present and rendering - showing related rows OR a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
